title: ASE Unveils IDE 2.0 – AI-Enhanced Platform Accelerates Package Design Accuracy and Innovation
summary: Discover the future of semiconductor design with ASE's IDE 2.0, a groundbreaking upgrade to the Integrated Design Ecosystem™. This enhanced platform integrates AI to streamline design iterations, optimize chip-package interactions, and accelerate time-to-market for AI and HPC applications. IDE 2.0 features an AI-driven feedback framework that connects design and analysis in real time, enabling faster innovation amid increasing architectural complexity. By combining multiphysics-based simulation, real-world data, and AI insights, IDE 2.0 dramatically improves speed, precision, and reliability in semiconductor package development-empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven design decisions.
